contextId.description: Stable identifier for this context, unique within a federated query

species.description: Whether this context defines what exists (extent) or how a reader reads it (lens)

rootId.description: Foreign key to roots.id — the corpus root this context is scoped to

extentContextId.description: For a lens, the contextId of the extent it reads over. Null for an extent, which is its own base.

projection-resolution-contexts.description: A row of the path-dependent `resolution_contexts` table. Note: the species/extentContextId correspondence and the tree/role gate are enforced by the Zod schema but not encoded in the generated JSON Schema.
